High-level APIs for loading Solana programs and deriving sBPF versions from feature state.

# Purpose
`fd_prog_load.h` defines the public interface for loading Solana program data from the account database. It declares [`fd_prog_load_elf`](<#fd_prog_load_elf>), which finds a program account, follows it to the program data account, and returns a pointer to the ELF image together with its size and write transaction ID. The file also defines `fd_prog_versions_t` and [`fd_prog_versions`](<#fd_prog_versions>), which derive the supported sBPF version range from the active feature set and slot. In addition, it defines `fd_prog_load_env_t` and [`fd_prog_load_env_from_bank`](<#fd_prog_load_env_from_bank>), which collect the feature and slot state needed for program loading.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_prog_load_elf`
- `fd_prog_versions`
- `fd_prog_load_env_from_bank`
